newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Lamalie rated buy, stock up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lamalie rated buy, stock up.

text.p: Shares of Lamalie Associates Inc rose Monday after the stock was rated a buy by Robert W. Baird & Co Inc.
-- Shares of Lamalie, the fifth largest U.S. executive search firm, rose 7/8 to 19-3/8, a new high.

-- Baird, the lead underwriter of the company's IPO earlier this month, gave the stock a 52-week price range of $15 to $19 and estimated fiscal 1998 earnings at $0.80 a share, and fiscal 1999 earnings at $0.91 a share.

-- "We believe Lamalie will continue to outshine the industry, growing internally at a 20 to 25 percent rate via adding consultants and clients and winning search assignments," Baird said in a research report.
-- It also said Lamalie could grow by acquisitions in a highly fragmented industry.
-- The stock first sold to IPO buyers for $12 a share and has only been as low as 15-1/4 in its three-week history on the public markets.
